application.title: Application
application.description: Essbase application name or Planning application name

database.title: Database / Cube
database.description: Essbase database (cube) name. Required for Essbase module.

query_mode.title: Query Mode
query_mode.description: Custom: write MDX manually. Builder: select dimensions and members visually — the component generates the MDX query automatically.

mdx_query.title: MDX Query
mdx_query.description: MDX SELECT statement for data extraction. Use {{since}} and {{until}} placeholders to insert the resolved start/end dates from the Incremental Loading settings below (e.g. WHERE [Time].CurrentMember IS [Time].[{{since}}]).

plan_type.title: Plan Type
plan_type.description: Plan type name for data export. Required for Planning module.

column_dimension.title: Column Dimension
column_dimension.description: The Essbase dimension whose members will appear as columns in the generated MDX query.

column_members.title: Column Members
column_members.description: Specific members from the Column Dimension to include on the COLUMNS axis. Leave empty to use all members (.Members).

row_dimensions.title: Row Dimensions
row_dimensions.description: Essbase dimensions to place on the ROWS axis. Multiple selections are combined with CrossJoin. Order matters.

output_table.title: Output Table Name
output_table.description: Name of the output table in Keboola Storage (without .csv extension)

incremental.title: Incremental Loading
incremental.description: When enabled, the component saves the end date of each run and uses it as the start date of the next run. Use {{since}} and {{until}} in your MDX query to inject the resolved dates.

since.title: Since (Start Date)
since.description: Start of the extraction window. Accepts relative values (e.g. 'yesterday', '3 days ago', 'last month') or absolute dates (YYYY-MM-DD). Use {{since}} in your MDX query to insert this value. When Incremental Loading is enabled and this field is empty, the end date of the previous run is used automatically.

until.title: Until (End Date)
until.description: End of the extraction window. Accepts relative values (e.g. 'today', 'yesterday') or absolute dates (YYYY-MM-DD). Use {{until}} in your MDX query. Leave empty to use the current timestamp.
